state:Andhra Pradesh.text: The Andhra Pradesh government has pursued extensive artificial intelligence initiatives focused on infrastructure development, education, and public service delivery. Major actions include partnering with technology giants such as Google and Reliance to establish multibillion-dollar hyperscale AI data centers and hubs in Visakhapatnam and Amaravati [R42588509, R1349768b, R37f1fbdf]. The state has also integrated AI across various governance sectors, deploying applications for urban flood forecasting, tax administration, healthcare delivery, and police monitoring [Rd4cc8595, R6e71a6d9, R84d949ed, R1e515ffc]. Additionally, Andhra Pradesh has advanced workforce readiness and education by introducing compulsory AI training for teachers, partnering with firms like IBM and Microsoft for youth skill development, and planning dedicated frontier technology universities [R06697b72, R9fe15d9b, R5237da05, Re98842fe].

state:Bihar.text: The Government of Bihar has actively pursued artificial intelligence integration across governance, education, and infrastructure sectors through major policy initiatives and partnerships [R57e2c2ec, Rff3cbb5a]. Key actions include signing significant Memorandums of Understanding with major technology firms like Google and Microsoft to train teachers and modernise the education ecosystem [Reb7bfdb3, R1b5b6306], alongside launching targeted youth training and state-governed AI infrastructure projects [Rb70e845b, Rbc0f7b3c]. The state has also deployed AI for administrative enhancements, such as paperless e-Cabinet operations, automated traffic surveillance, and public service delivery monitoring [Re986d143, Rca207298, R6e8b2377].

state:Gujarat.text: The Government of Gujarat has actively advanced artificial intelligence through infrastructure development, targeted governance applications, and educational initiatives. Key infrastructure efforts include the establishment of AI and data center clusters near GIFT City [Rb322fa47, R42b5efe9], a statewide GPU-as-a-Service framework [Rd1b68bba], and the Data Centre Policy 2026-29 aiming for Green AI capacity and mandatory renewable power integration [Re041bd74, R0d737a25, R43f4ae2b]. State governance is leveraging AI across sectors such as agricultural paddy quality testing [Re71562c3], dairy farming guidance via the Amul AI platform [Ra310e3fc], police surveillance challenges [R28ccc09b], and student dropout prevention [R88fee491]. Additionally, the state has initiated a major student training mission targeting 5 lakh students and thousands of faculty members [Ra6932da2], while the Gujarat High Court has concurrently enacted policies prohibiting AI use in judicial decision-making and judgment drafting [Rbd9766bd].

state:Karnataka.text: Karnataka has actively pursued artificial intelligence integration across governance, education, and infrastructure through various strategic policy measures and partnerships [R65d60606, R2c127a87]. The state has focused heavily on educational reforms, including plans for an AI university, introducing AI and digital literacy into school curricula starting from Class 6, and establishing multiple Centres of Excellence and AI hubs [R8176ca19, R0e4ecbd7, Rb77b1a7f]. Additionally, the government has adopted AI for public service delivery and administrative efficiency, deploying tools for attendance tracking, crop surveys, language translation via Bhashini, and citizen service pilots with companies like ElevenLabs [Rf518fff6, Ra61ec765, Rff273deb, R9d27904f]. Large-scale infrastructure projects such as the Bidadi AI Township and the launch of affordable KEO computers further underline the state's push to expand its digital and deep-tech ecosystem [R3590a0eb, R9082b90f].

state:Maharashtra.text: Maharashtra has actively advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem by approving a comprehensive AI policy backed by a ₹10,000 crore planned investment, establishing a dedicated IT and AI department, and deploying governance and oversight committees [R562864e1, Rd7d40f74, Rbff13ca0, R5afedf9c]. The state government has integrated AI across numerous public sectors, implementing initiatives such as the Maha AI and MahaINDUS governance platforms, police cybercrime copilots, and multilingual tools in partnership with tech entities like Microsoft, Google, and Sarvam AI [R04592b70, R68fee1a0, R7ec03dda, R03b6b6d6]. Furthermore, Maharashtra has driven large-scale infrastructure and educational projects, including massive data centre investments, mandatory teacher training, and specialized agricultural and safety programs [Re0b416d1, R2889d124, Rcd594eaf, Radc0ac36].

state:Odisha.text: Odisha has advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through major infrastructure investments, including partnerships with companies like Sarvam AI and HCLTech to develop sovereign AI parks, data centers, and compute facilities [R31b27cb7, Re1e1271, R3a36bb44]. The state government has integrated AI into public administration and citizen services, deploying WhatsApp chatbots like 'Ama Sathi' for governance and revenue services, alongside AI surveillance for exams and automated traffic enforcement [Rabdf8555, R478c8c67, R8a2dd09f, R05090e42]. Additionally, Odisha has focused on education and workforce readiness by introducing AI curricula across schools and higher education institutions while launching specialized training programs [Rdb5da3c5, R7b1537aa, R7b9bb8d3].

state:Punjab.text: Punjab has pursued extensive artificial intelligence integration across education, governance, agriculture, and law enforcement. The state school education board introduced AI into the computer science curriculum and public school system for classes across various grade levels [Rf6319e99, R11fad9f5, Rf4a0d422]. In policing and public safety, the state partnered with IIT Ropar to establish an in-house AI laboratory and deployed smart technologies like voice recognition and automated tracking to combat organized crime [R7333c0ad, R132d8a77, R3ee3be90]. Additionally, Punjab advanced agricultural advisory services and healthcare diagnostics through AI-driven tools [Ree614b14, R609b6fc5].

state:Tamil Nadu.text: Tamil Nadu has driven extensive artificial intelligence adoption through infrastructure developments, public service automation, and targeted educational initiatives. Key infrastructure projects include partnering to establish a Sovereign AI Park, inaugurating South India's largest AI-ready data center campus, and collaborating with IIT Madras to create an AI Data Centre and state-owned GPU cluster [R472c3c1a, R70cb396d, R305828a2, R8b2c535d]. The state has enhanced public service delivery by deploying WhatsApp chatbots like 'Namma Arasu' for government services and launching AI systems for wildlife conservation, healthcare appointment booking, and policing [R494484b4, R31409be3, R576baa19, R76baa146]. Furthermore, Tamil Nadu has integrated AI into its education system by training government school students and teachers, launching specialized AI learning platforms, and introducing AI trades in vocational training institutes [R9cd35018, Rfe24cede, Re04bb5c4, R5742a9b1].

state:Telangana.text: Telangana has actively pursued artificial intelligence integration across infrastructure, governance, and education through strategic partnerships and institutional frameworks [Rd6f74125, R389847d5]. The state has attracted massive investments for AI data centers and cloud infrastructure, alongside plans for a dedicated AI City [R5b4a7a80, Ra0d04f11, Rfd882f23]. Government initiatives leverage AI for public services, including policing, traffic management, agricultural market transactions, and revenue collection [Ra1409382, Rce4536fa, R45e372bd, R849548ed]. Furthermore, the state has launched extensive skilling and literacy programs to train students and government employees in artificial intelligence [R6843cc3b, R89c590e8, R59295049].

state:Uttar Pradesh.text: Uttar Pradesh has advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through major infrastructure projects, governance initiatives, and large-scale skilling programs [R7945996b]. The state cabinet approved the UP Artificial Intelligence Mission alongside data center and robotics policies aimed at establishing AI hubs and attracting multi-billion-dollar investments in cities like Lucknow and Noida [Rb1cbd4df, Rb312992b, R398131aa]. Furthermore, the government has integrated AI into public administration and exam monitoring, while partnering with major tech firms to train millions of youth in emerging technologies [Re0c4ff32, Rf4058825, R1a841461].

category:strategy_policy.text: Indian state governments have increasingly prioritized AI strategy and policy, introducing dedicated missions, legislative frameworks, and substantial financial investments to boost regional ecosystems [R6a6bee70, R562864e1, Rb312992b]. States like Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, and Bihar have approved comprehensive AI policies and missions aimed at establishing tech hubs, expanding infrastructure, and training hundreds of thousands of students [R4af400f2, R562864e1, Rb312992b]. Additionally, administrations are focusing on specialized infrastructure through data centre policies, green AI data centres, and targeted startup ecosystems [R3eefbde9, Re041bd74, R398131aa]. State-level initiatives also heavily emphasize governance reforms, utilizing artificial intelligence for public service delivery, administrative overhauls, agricultural monitoring, and revenue generation [R45e372bd, R849548ed, R8f4114ad].

category:regulation_ethics.text: Indian states and high courts have actively established regulatory guardrails, ethical frameworks, and administrative safeguards for artificial intelligence. Judicial bodies in states like Gujarat, Kerala, and Punjab and Haryana have introduced restrictive policies barring the use of AI tools in drafting judgments or arriving at judicial decisions [Rbd9766bd, R12b7585e, R8eacd504]. Concurrently, executive departments in states such as Telangana, Rajasthan, and Karnataka have formed dedicated committees and issued guidelines to ensure the ethical use of AI, protect taxpayer and student data privacy, and mandate labeling for synthetic or AI-generated content [R9b3c768e, R607d069a, R7c216cfc]. Furthermore, several administrations are formulating standard operating procedures to govern emerging technologies like wearable devices and automated surveillance tools [Rba8badb1, Raedfea70].

category:funding_budget.text: Indian state governments have launched substantial financial commitments and funding mechanisms to drive artificial intelligence infrastructure, data centers, and specialized missions. Notable initiatives include multi-year state missions and large-scale infrastructure investments, such as Chhattisgarh's Rs 500 crore AI Mission and Uttar Pradesh's multi-crore AI and skill development programs [R7cc53f61, Rb312992b, R297b1b1d]. States are also attracting massive private capital and international partnerships for high-capacity data centers and sovereign compute projects, ranging from large agreements in Odisha and Andhra Pradesh to major proposals in Maharashtra and Bihar [Rd3f465ac, R3eefbde9, R00b3c6a6, R3a36bb44]. Additionally, funds are being directed toward sector-specific applications such as agriculture, wildlife protection, and workforce skilling to integrate AI across public governance and higher education [R68fee1a0, Radc0ac36, R5c8784f8, R311c8976].

category:infrastructure.text: State governments across India have actively driven AI infrastructure development through major investments in data centers, hyperscale campuses, and dedicated technology hubs. States like Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Uttar Pradesh, and Odisha have secured massive private investments for gigawatt-scale AI data centers, sovereign compute projects, and specialized AI cities [R31b27cb7, R5b4a7a80, R42588509, R398131aa, R00b3c6a6]. Additionally, multiple states are establishing AI universities, research centers of excellence, and specialized parks—such as robotics hubs and GPUaaS frameworks—to bolster local tech ecosystems, skilling, and public sector innovation [Rc16dddf8, R2d894836, Rb1cbd4df, Rd1b68bba, Ra4c0792f].

category:partnership.text: Indian state governments have actively pursued partnerships and Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with major technology firms, academic institutions, and industry leaders to build artificial intelligence infrastructure, data centers, and skilling programs. States like Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Gujarat, Karnataka, Maharashtra, and Telangana have secured massive investments for hyperscale AI data centers, specialized compute hubs, and Centres of Excellence [R42588509, R44971ae6, Reff5d158, Re0b416d1, R998e03d5]. Additionally, several states have engaged companies such as Google, Microsoft, and ElevenLabs to modernize education, train government teachers in AI literacy, deploy voice-powered citizen services, and improve public governance and healthcare delivery [Reb7bfdb3, R2889d124, Rff273deb, R6473839f]. These collaborative initiatives reflect a widespread regional push to expand localized digital economies, foster startup ecosystems, and integrate artificial intelligence across public administration and education [R65d2a417, R65d60606].

category:deployment.text: Indian state governments are actively deploying artificial intelligence across diverse sectors such as public service delivery, law enforcement, education, and healthcare [Rd731fc75, R3590a0eb, R04592b70, Rd2e6b41c]. Significant initiatives include conversational AI chatbots for citizen services via WhatsApp, AI-powered surveillance and transcription tools in the justice and police systems, and specialized educational computers and digital platforms [Rabdf8555, R04592b70, Rd2e6b41c, Rf2c35456]. States are also leveraging AI for administrative efficiency, revenue monitoring, and regional language preservation through partnerships with major technology companies and public entities [Rd731fc75, Rad868781, Rccf3ba89, R6e1a6d9].

category:skilling.text: State governments have launched extensive AI skilling and educational initiatives, introducing AI curricula, subjects, and learning programmes in schools. For example, Punjab made AI a mainstream subject for Classes I to XII [Rf6319e99], Karnataka introduced AI classes starting from Class 6 and vocational subjects for Classes 9 and 10 [R8176ca19, R3e7508f6], and Sikkim rolled out an AI-powered learning programme for early grades [R27258895]. States are also partnering with major technology firms and institutions like Google and Microsoft to train teachers and youth in AI literacy and digital skills [Reb7bfdb3, R2889d124, R06697b72]. Additionally, several states have approved dedicated AI missions and large-scale training targets for students and professionals [Rb312992b, Ra6932da2, R6843cc3b].

category:events_outreach.text: States across India have extensively engaged in AI outreach through large-scale summits, tech expos, and regional conferences focusing on governance, infrastructure, and future-ready skills [R84a7e58c, Rec3b838b, Reb9a8d36, Rcfaf8a9a]. Major events like the Bengaluru Tech Summit, Telangana Global AI Summit, and various regional AI impact conferences served as platforms for forging global partnerships, showcasing innovation ecosystems, and driving investments [R84a7e58c, Rec3b838b, R1dd96b45, Reb9a8d36]. Additionally, governments and law enforcement agencies organized targeted boot camps, capacity-building workshops, and hackathons—such as police surveillance and language model training challenges—to foster local technical talent [Rb8c534c6, R28ccc09b, R1841ffbd, Rb77a4651]. Educational initiatives and student-focused skill programs were also rolled out across multiple states to promote technical awareness and responsible adoption [R3fff65a8, R51ca07a8, Raecda2fb].

state:Kerala.text: Kerala has advanced artificial intelligence initiatives across governance, education, law enforcement, and infrastructure development. The state government rebranded its IT department to focus on AI and future technologies, established twin AI Centres of Excellence, and attracted major investments such as a large AI-driven data centre [Rcaa18758, Ref58a154, Ra525c46d]. In the public sector and judiciary, authorities integrated AI-assisted administrative overhauls, translation and transcription tools, and traffic monitoring systems alongside robotics and cyber safety protocols [Rf2c35456, R8f4114ad, Raf4f7b8d, R70b2d101]. Educational programs have also seen widespread AI integration, ranging from specialized school training and robotics mandates to generative AI tools for students and teachers [R0689eb15, R3db21292, Rb2b9a51b, Rc3656b09].

category:governance_body.text: Several Indian states have established high-level governance structures, ministerial portfolios, and specialized administrative bodies to oversee artificial intelligence policy and adoption [R6bbe2d82, R3f8abae4, Rfb71877d]. Kerala and Tamil Nadu created dedicated AI ministerial positions and restructured their information technology departments to focus on artificial intelligence and future technologies [R6bbe2d82, Ref58a154, Ref475c84]. Other states such as Maharashtra, Gujarat, Karnataka, and Bihar have formed targeted committees, task forces, and special cells to manage AI policy implementation, ethical governance, and sector-specific applications [R3f8abae4, R301d6af1, R9b3c768e, Rfb71877d]. Additionally, police and law enforcement agencies in states like Telangana, West Bengal, Haryana, and Jharkhand have moved to create specialized AI units and task forces for tech-driven policing [Ra1409382, Re268e526, Ra6b5d331, R25c27df1].

overall.text: Across Indian states, artificial intelligence initiatives are heavily focused on infrastructure development, education, and public service delivery. Major investments include large-scale data center projects and AI cities planned in states like Odisha, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana [R31b27cb7, R1b6cbab3, R5b4a7a80, R42588509]. States such as Punjab, Karnataka, Bihar, and Sikkim have introduced AI into school curricula or launched dedicated student training programs [Rf6319e99, R8176ca19, R4af400f2, R27258895]. Additionally, governments are leveraging AI for governance, policing, and language preservation through various regional portals, task forces, and partnerships [Rd731fc75, R04592b70, Rad868781, R3158dd4a].

state:Assam.text: Assam has actively integrated artificial intelligence across governance, public services, and infrastructure, establishing an AI roadmap and commissioning its first government-owned GPU cluster to power state services [R936eb0aa, R4203359c]. Key initiatives include deploying AI for flood and disaster management such as the 'Jal Raksha' WhatsApp relief platform, forest and wildlife protection using satellite monitoring and AI cameras, and education reforms that incorporate AI tools in schools alongside Google and UNICEF [R9c52da90, Rc2490b65, R39b50ddb, R18a33cd7]. Additionally, the state has advanced AI applications in healthcare with patient monitoring and robotic surgeries, while also implementing regulatory and legal measures to counter deepfakes and the misuse of AI-generated content [R5068779c, Rdc188dd0, Rf972ff43].

state:Chhattisgarh.text: Chhattisgarh has advanced its artificial intelligence initiatives through the approval of a Rs 500 crore AI Mission over five years, focusing on digital economy, governance, and skill development [R7cc53f61]. The state has also concentrated on infrastructure investments, including foundations for AI data center parks and special economic zones in Nava Raipur [Rcc6c8e84, Rd28b546d]. In the education sector, the government partnered with Google India to launch an AI education campaign aimed at training over 2 lakh teachers and integrating technology into tribal and rural schools [R398fad0d, Rf7c7fd70]. Furthermore, public services have integrated AI applications across domains, ranging from wildlife conservation and police investigations to road monitoring and automated alert systems [R96ea213d, Reb028d74, Re3198684, R6c86e7f3].

state:Haryana.text: Haryana has advanced its technology-driven governance framework through major initiatives such as the Haryana AI Development Project and plans for an AI data centre and sandbox environments [R127f881c, R56704031, R03b25e4d]. The state government is integrating artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, including a police modernization plan focused on cybercrime tracking, drone-driven surveillance models, and AI-backed tools for tuberculosis screening and agriculture [Ra6b5d331, Rdb9464b3, Rf90e65a4, R8677362d]. Additionally, educational reforms are introducing AI and vocational subjects into schools, Industrial Training Institutes, and upcoming digital colleges in Gurugram and Panchkula [Rcd5e27a7, Rf9aabd25, Rb029010f].

state:Himachal Pradesh.text: Himachal Pradesh has actively integrated artificial intelligence across education, governance, and public services, including the launch of digital learning tools like the 'Padhai with AI' app in Bilaspur and the incorporation of AI curricula in schools [Rb23a865a, Rbc10366f]. The state government has advanced AI-driven administrative systems, such as document verification on the Him Seva Portal and meeting management platforms, alongside healthcare initiatives like robotic-assisted surgeries and AI fraud-detection in the Himcare scheme [R38e56e62, R1ba6a5ba, Rc3a3d3b4, Reb98bbcd]. Furthermore, institutional collaborations with bodies like IIT Mandi have driven projects in forest intelligence, ecological restoration, disaster resilience, and deepfake detection [Rd81af6f6, Re6fc0429, R26835c79, Rc06b19cc].

state:Jharkhand.text: Jharkhand has advanced artificial intelligence initiatives across governance, healthcare, education, and infrastructure, anchored by the launch of the Jharkhand AI Policy 2026 and the Jharkhand AI Vision-2050 roadmap [R4b4e0b34, R927ec078]. The state government has integrated AI into public administration and public safety, utilizing AI-based cameras, drones, and surveillance systems for crowd monitoring during events and wildlife tracking to mitigate human-animal conflicts [R96eaad17, R558f4a5f, R118b938d]. Furthermore, healthcare and education sectors are seeing substantial modernization, including digital health conclaves, AI-powered learning platforms in schools, and new AI training programs for officials and students [Rd25878d1, Rfd41fa83, R36a0ee65, Rb74fac99].

state:Madhya Pradesh.text: Madhya Pradesh is actively integrating artificial intelligence across public administration, infrastructure development, and economic planning under Chief Minister Mohan Yadav's leadership. Key initiatives include partnering with Google Cloud for AI-driven governance, attracting major investments for AI-ready data centers and chip packaging facilities, and deploying AI surveillance for crowd management during the Simhastha 2028 preparations [R12d4ab71, R6473839f, Rac12a0cd, R4df0843d]. Additionally, the state has applied AI to real-time forest and environmental monitoring, public transport optimization, and civic procurement auditing [Rc8beb73d, R7c96135c, R4c96f220].

state:Manipur.text: Manipur has actively integrated artificial intelligence across governance, education, legal proceedings, and conservation efforts [Rbb7d36a7, Rc647f8ab, R7249ca9d]. Notable initiatives include the Manipur High Court utilizing AI tools like ChatGPT for judicial research and landmark verdicts, alongside partnerships with BHASHINI and Microsoft to expand multilingual AI, cybersecurity, and digital governance [Rad868781, Rdc31ca32, R647a600d]. The state has also promoted AI in academic and career settings through workshops, university programs, and the opening of an AI career guidance hub in an Imphal school [Rbb7d36a7, R546f135d, R13590541]. Furthermore, AI applications are being explored for wildlife trafficking prevention, tribal development, and digital tourism [R7249ca9d, R3413274d, Re9f95033].

state:Meghalaya.text: Meghalaya is actively integrating artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, including governance, education, agriculture, and public health, positioning itself as a leader in tech-driven development [Radc3741c, Rf1f88f85, R84a1eeb7]. Significant actions include drafting a new IT policy focused on AI and global capability centres, proposing a Rs 20 crore AI Centre of Excellence at Shillong Technology Park Phase II, and introducing AI-enabled learning initiatives in schools [R9625f972, Rf277c3a3, R24be49c9]. Additionally, the state has leveraged data-driven governance to improve public health metrics, deployed AI solutions for environmental and waste management, and hosted the Regional Artificial Intelligence Impact Conference [Rac5495f0, Rd7994ab1, R84a1eeb7].

state:Tripura.text: Tripura has undertaken extensive initiatives to integrate artificial intelligence across governance, public administration, and law enforcement, including deploying AI-based tools for tax evasion detection, traffic management, and police control rooms [Ra65da593, R8edb04a8, Rdc265ce0]. The state is launching a state-level AI policy and partnering with Google India and IIT Kharagpur to build a robust local technology and innovation ecosystem [Rc68da9b5, R33168f25, R9435f1d2]. Furthermore, Tripura has emphasized AI-driven advancements in education, healthcare, and agriculture, such as introducing free AI courses for school students, AI-powered school monitoring, and AI medical equipment [R2235629e, R3fff65a8, R20047d48, R12023632].

state:Uttarakhand.text: Uttarakhand has advanced its artificial intelligence agenda through several summits, educational expansions, and governance initiatives. Key actions include launching the Devbhoomi AI Summit and establishing AI courses across universities and institutions to enhance digital literacy [R8a719696, Rcea6d545]. The state has also deployed AI for practical applications such as wildlife conservation, forest monitoring, cyber fraud helplines, and revenue collection [R549f779d, Recb1f69d, Rf32d6d42, R82962675]. Additionally, AI is being integrated into public infrastructure security, transport, and administrative portals to improve governance and safety [R9dac4ef2, Rc3235cc0].

state:West Bengal.text: West Bengal is actively integrating artificial intelligence across economic, educational, and governance domains to drive industrial revival and modernization [R2434d991, R1ada3e48]. The state's industrial strategy features initiatives such as the West Bengal AI Mission, a draft industrial policy focusing on data centers and AI, and the accelerated Silicon Valley project [Rf93d2652, R0c1ea7de, R90ad9af5]. In education, the state has introduced AI, data science, and coding curricula across schools and higher secondary boards, alongside workforce training partnerships with entities like Oracle [Rac4428c1, Rf61a82a3, R6da26467, R0c4d9eef]. Additionally, law enforcement and public administration are utilizing AI through dedicated police cells, investigation apps like Samarth, and AI-powered public helplines [Re268e526, R904a08ab, R08e415eb].

state:Rajasthan.text: The Rajasthan government has integrated artificial intelligence across numerous sectors, supported by policies like the AI-ML Policy 2026 and initiatives in digital governance and public services [R6a6bee70, R250bc457, Re0df1048]. Major advancements include the adoption of AI-driven solutions in agriculture through partnerships with Wadhwani AI, health tracking initiatives for diabetes and tuberculosis, and enhanced policing via facial recognition and automated traffic management [R6de84b70, Rb6d56877, Rd7e6b721, Re141ed2f]. Additionally, the state has advanced educational frameworks by introducing AI foundational courses, planning syllabus updates for schools, and leveraging institutional research from organizations like IIT Jodhpur [Rae2f7609, Rf789607f, R2c694631].

state:Nagaland.text: Nagaland has actively integrated artificial intelligence across governance, public administration, and specialized sectors such as disaster preparedness, agriculture, law enforcement, and animal production [Ra8c17a13, R3a286812, R17676278, Rbf1aee2c]. Significant initiatives include launching an AI supercomputer, an AI-powered digital agriculture ecosystem, police surveillance cameras, and award-winning WhatsApp chatbots to improve public services and skill development access [Ra8c17a13, R3a286812, R1ee21379, R17676278, Rb26a6b87]. The state has also prioritized education and capacity building through the inauguration of an AI Centre of Excellence for Skilling, faculty development workshops, and plans to introduce an AI curriculum in schools starting from Class 6 [R6f55ee54, Rb7d1d850, R8b9ea930, Ree819f7b].

state:Sikkim.text: Sikkim has actively integrated artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, most notably deploying an AI-driven Traffic Management System and e-challan mechanisms to enhance road safety and manage traffic congestion [Re7e20a6f, R24fc93a2, Ref56657c]. In education and agriculture, the state has launched AI-powered learning programs in government schools, partnered with NIELIT Gangtok to establish an AI Centre of Excellence, and pilot-tested an AI-enabled WhatsApp chatbot to support farmers [R27258895, Red4520ff, R2569fc2d]. Additionally, the government has advanced technology adoption by introducing an AI-based permit system to boost tourism and discussing AI applications for disaster prediction and higher education partnerships [Rfc6c0173, Rb685bb8f, R604d927c].
